title: Meals to organise
intro: Suggest several dates to your guests: they vote without an account from a link you share on WhatsApp, then you set the date.
incomplete: Add guests and dates to start the vote.

share.label: Voting link to share
share.message: Hello! To organise “{title}”, tell us when you are available: {url}

form.title: Meal name
form.guestPlaceholder: First name (or several, separated by commas)
form.datesHint: You can add a date at any time, for example if nobody is available: guests can vote again.
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. Drinks at home, bring the kids!
form.peopleHint: A couple or a family can share one line: enter the number of people, they will answer together.
form.totalPeople: {n} guest in total | {n} guests in total
form.datesPick: Tap the days to suggest (several allowed), tap again to remove. An orange dot marks a day already taken.
form.busyDay: Day already taken (calendar or another meal)

close.title: Set the meal date
close.createGuests: Add these guests to {slot} in meals
close.createEvent: Add an event to the calendar
close.hint: The chosen date will also be shown on the guests' voting page.

reopenMessage: The vote will be reopened; the guests added to meals and the event created for the chosen date will be removed.

delete.title: Delete the meal to organise
delete.mealMessage: The date of this meal is set to {date}.
delete.mealDescription: Also delete the guests added to this meal and the calendar event?

vote.instructions: For each date, tell us whether you are available.
vote.saved: Thank you, your answers are saved. You can change them at any time with this link.
vote.notFound: This link is no longer valid.
vote.instructionsGroup: You are answering for {n} people. For each date, tell us whether you are available.
